xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4473: Shared Sessions v0 (slice 2): host share action, share record and lobby panel

plan.title: Shared Sessions v0 (slice 2): host share action, share record and lobby panel
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: 23 files across 8 path-subsystems only because mandated registries live outside src/ (tests/unit/lib/overdeck/no-loss-matrix.ts, scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt, the Miniflare harness under tests/integration/) and each docs/*.md counts as its own subsystem. The code is one vertical feature (create share -> host socket -> routes -> lobby UI); splitting it would ship a backend with no UI or a UI with no backend, and sibling slices PAN-4474..PAN-4482 already carry the rest of Shared Sessions.

narratives.Problem: Slice 1 (PAN-658) built the Cloudflare share service, but nothing on a user's machine can create a room, hold its host token, or admit anyone. Slices 3-11 all assume a host that has created a room, holds the host signaling socket, and can admit viewers from a lobby.
narratives.Proposal: Add a 0600 share record file door (src/lib/sharing/share-record.ts), a share service HTTP client with anywhere.share_url config (src/lib/sharing/share-service.ts), a dashboard-server ShareManager that creates rooms with the PAN-4330 device token and parks one host WebSocket per room (src/dashboard/server/services/share-host.ts), four /api/shares routes that never expose the host token, and a frontend 'Share this conversation' menu action, share dialog and lobby panel with one-click Admit as contributor. Prove it with unit, route and Miniflare integration tests plus Playwright screenshots. Full design: .pan/drafts/PAN-4473.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- WebRTC, data channels, the content wire format or the conversation bridge (slice 3, PAN-4474); signal and ice-servers frames are ignored
- Reconnecting the host socket after a network drop or re-parking after a dashboard restart (slice 8, PAN-4479)
- Viewer side: join intent, viewer socket, /#/shared/<roomId> route (slice 4, PAN-4475)
- Controller handoff or reclaim; no set-controller command is exposed (slice 7, PAN-4478)
- pan share / pan join CLI (slice 9, PAN-4480)
- A /ws/rpc push event for share state
- The sidebar right-click menu mirror in CommandDeck/ConversationActionMenu.tsx
- Any change to services/share/ or its existing tests
- New src/lib/errors.ts tags or new route-scopes.ts rows
- Raising any file-size allowlist row or touching src/dashboard/server/main.ts
- Deploying anything to Cloudflare
- Exposing the host token to the browser, logs or error messages

autoDecisions.summary: Host socket opens on create and does not reconnect or re-park in this slice (D-1).
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-4479 (slice 8) explicitly owns reconnect after a network drop or restart; the room survives 5 minutes on the service either way.

autoDecisions.summary: A stale record (no live socket) is listed as disconnected with snapshot null, and End share works on it (D-2).
autoDecisions.rationale: HTTP DELETE needs only the host token, so one end path handles live and stale shares.

autoDecisions.summary: POST /api/shares on an already-live share returns 200 with the existing view; a stale record is ended first, then a new room is created (D-3).
autoDecisions.rationale: Re-opening the dialog must never mint a second link; one share per conversation is the PRD rule.

autoDecisions.summary: Server-side eligibility: getConversationByName (404) and conversationWriteRefusal (409) gate POST /api/shares (D-4).
autoDecisions.rationale: The frontend runsHere gate is a convenience; the server must refuse linked, vault and released conversations itself.

autoDecisions.summary: Signed-out machine -> 412 not_signed_in; unreadable account.json -> 500 account_unreadable (D-5).
autoDecisions.rationale: Gives the dialog a distinct, actionable signed-out state pointing at pan account login.

autoDecisions.summary: Lobby live updates by polling GET /api/shares every 1000 ms while the dialog is open (D-6).
autoDecisions.rationale: Snapshot lives in server memory so a poll is a local read; a /ws/rpc event would touch 5+ files for a panel open only while sharing; 159 refetchInterval precedents.

autoDecisions.summary: Share URL is config.yaml anywhere.share_url, default https://share.overdeck.ai, validated like anywhere.directory_url (D-7).
autoDecisions.rationale: Mirrors the dashboard-server precedent for the sibling overdeck.ai directory service; a Settings save keeps the anywhere block.

autoDecisions.summary: Lib and service modules are plain async with injected seams; routes are Effect HttpRouter wrapping them with Effect.promise (D-8). Overrides the parent PRD 'Effect-native' sentence.
autoDecisions.rationale: directory-client.ts is the closest precedent and the one-variant-per-operation rule forbids Effect wrappers over Promise code.

autoDecisions.summary: No new src/lib/errors.ts tags; JSON string error codes (D-9).
autoDecisions.rationale: Nothing in this slice runs in an Effect error channel; matches routes/triggers.ts and the share service.

autoDecisions.summary: End share always uses HTTP DELETE /v1/rooms/:code; 204 and 404 both mean gone (D-10).
autoDecisions.rationale: Works with or without a live socket.

autoDecisions.summary: Keepalive via ws protocol ping every 30 s, 75 s pong deadline, verified in Miniflare with a fallback (D-11).
autoDecisions.rationale: Detects a silently dead socket; the fallback keeps the slice shippable if workerd ignores pings.

autoDecisions.summary: Commands answer 202 and the effect shows in the next snapshot; the latest service error frame is shown as lastError (D-12).
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the route simple; polling at 1 s surfaces the change quickly.

autoDecisions.summary: Menu item lives in sharing/ShareDialog.tsx; ConversationPanel.tsx gets +2 lines; sidebar menu mirror is out of scope (D-13).
autoDecisions.rationale: ConversationPanel.tsx has 11 lines of headroom under its 1531 allowlist cap.

autoDecisions.summary: Share record adds joinUrl to the PRD's record shape (D-15).
autoDecisions.rationale: A stale record can still show its link; additive for slice 8.

autoDecisions.summary: The Playwright screenshot spec is not added to the test:playwright CI script (D-16).
autoDecisions.rationale: That script lists four layout specs; a mocked-API screenshot spec is verification evidence, not a per-PR gate.

autoDecisions.summary: The issue's '/api/shares/*' route naming wins over the parent PRD's '/api/sessions' wording.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue body is newer and the slice map in docs/SHARED-SESSIONS.md already says /api/shares/*.

items.title: Add host dashboard share API types to contracts sharing.ts

expected_outputs: typecheck (including typecheck:share and typecheck:frontend) completes with exit 0

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. Append the 'Contracts' block from .pan/drafts/PAN-4473.md (section Design → Contracts) to packages/contracts/src/sharing.ts: ShareConnection, ShareCommand (= Extract<HostFrame, {type: 'admit'|'kick'|'revoke'|'unrevoke'|'set-contributor'}>), CreateShareRequest, ShareLastError, ShareView, ListSharesResponse. The file must stay type-only with no import statement (D-R3-8: services/share imports it by relative path). ShareView must not have a hostToken field. Update the header comment to mention PAN-4473.

items.title: Given packages/contracts/src/sharing.ts after the change, when it is read, then it exports ShareView, ShareCommand, ShareConnection, CreateShareRequest, ListSharesResponse and contains no import statement
Given the ShareView interface, when its fields are listed, then it has shortCode, joinUrl, scope, createdAt, connection, snapshot and lastError and no hostToken field

Create the shared-sessions.json share record door

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2 and Design → 'Share record file door'. Create src/lib/sharing/share-record.ts exporting SHARED_SESSIONS_FILENAME, ShareRecord, ShareRecordFile, sharedSessionsPath, readShareRecords, putShareRecord, removeShareRecord, findShareRecordByScope. File ${OVERDECK_HOME}/shared-sessions.json, {version:1, rooms:{<shortCode>:{scopeKind,scopeId,hostToken,joinUrl,createdAt}}}. Import only Node built-ins and ../paths.js. Writes: one in-process queue (copy mutate() from src/lib/access-tokens.ts lines 277-286), mkdir 0o700, temp file <path>.<pid>.<uuid>.tmp with mode 0o600, rename, unlink temp on failure. Read validation per the PRD; errors name the path and never contain a token. putShareRecord throws when a different short code already holds the same (scopeKind, scopeId). Tests isolate OVERDECK_HOME with mkdtemp like tests/unit/lib/account/store.test.ts.

items.title: Given a temp OVERDECK_HOME, when putShareRecord writes a record, then readShareRecords returns it and the file mode & 0o777 equals 0o600
Given a record for conversation X under code A, when putShareRecord is called for conversation X under code B, then it rejects with an error naming conversation X and code A
Given a shared-sessions.json with invalid JSON or a malformed hostToken, when readShareRecords runs, then it throws an error whose message contains the file path and does not contain odh_
Given no file, when readShareRecords runs, then it returns {} and removeShareRecord for an unknown code returns false
Given two concurrent putShareRecord calls for different codes and scopes, when both settle, then the file persists both records
Create the share service HTTP client and anywhere.share_url config reader

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3 and Design → 'Share service client'. Create src/lib/sharing/share-service.ts: DEFAULT_SHARE_URL='https://share.overdeck.ai', SHARE_HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS=10000, parseShareUrl/readShareUrl (config.yaml key anywhere.share_url; same validation as parseDirectoryUrl in src/lib/anywhere/directory-config.ts lines 24-41, reuse isLoopbackOrigin from src/lib/remote-access/loopback.ts), hostSocketUrl(base, code) -> ws(s)://.../v1/rooms/<code>/host?v=1, createRoom(base, deviceToken, scope, {fetch}) and deleteRoom(base, code, hostToken, {fetch}) returning {ok:true,...} | {ok:false,status,error}. Timeouts use AbortController + setTimeout (never AbortSignal.timeout). deleteRoom treats 204 and 404 as ok. Never log; never put a token in an error. Tests inject fetch and use vi.useFakeTimers + advanceTimersByTimeAsync for the timeout.

items.title: Given base https://share.overdeck.ai and code BCDFGHJK, when hostSocketUrl runs, then it returns wss://share.overdeck.ai/v1/rooms/BCDFGHJK/host?v=1
Given an injected fetch answering 201 with a valid CreateRoomResponse, when createRoom runs, then the request carries Authorization: Bearer odd_... and body {scope}, and the result is {ok:true, room}
Given an injected fetch that never resolves, when fake timers advance 10000 ms, then createRoom resolves {ok:false, status:null, error:'timeout'}
Given an injected fetch answering 404, when deleteRoom runs, then it resolves {ok:true}; given 503 it resolves {ok:false, status:503}
Given config.yaml with anywhere.share_url: http://example.com, when readShareUrl runs, then it returns an error; with no key it returns the default URL
Create the ShareManager host socket manager in the dashboard server

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4 and Design → 'Host socket manager' (decisions D-1, D-3, D-5, D-10, D-11, D-12). Create src/dashboard/server/services/share-host.ts modeled on src/dashboard/server/services/directory-client.ts: ShareSocket interface over the ws package, ShareManagerDeps (readAccount, readShareUrl, createRoom, deleteRoom, records, openSocket, now), ShareManager with create/list/command/end/stop, defaultOpenSocket, getShareManager (lazy singleton), setShareManagerForTests. Plain async class, no Effect (D-8). Follow the create steps 1-8 exactly: existing live share -> existing; in-flight dedupe per scope; record written BEFORE openSocket; host socket Authorization: Bearer <hostToken>. Socket handling: room frame -> connected + snapshot; error frame -> lastError; close 4004 or unexpected-response 404/401 -> remove record; close 4008 -> lastError replaced; any other close/error/pong timeout -> disconnected, record kept, no reconnect. Protocol ping every 30 s, terminate after 75 s without pong. command rebuilds the frame from known keys. end uses HTTP deleteRoom. list builds views field-by-field, never spreading a record. Tests: fake ShareSocket (EventEmitter + sent[]), fake deps, vi.useFakeTimers.

items.title: Given fake deps, when create runs for a new scope, then records.put is called before openSocket and openSocket receives Authorization: Bearer odh_<64 hex> and a URL ending /host?v=1
Given two concurrent create calls for the same scope, when both settle, then createRoom was called once and the second result has kind existing or the same shortCode
Given a live host, when the socket emits close 4004, then the record is removed and list() omits it; when it emits close 1006 instead, then list() reports connection disconnected and the record stays
Given a connected host and fake timers, when 75000 ms pass with no pong, then the socket is terminated and the view becomes disconnected
Given any sequence of create/list calls, when JSON.stringify(await manager.list()) is evaluated, then it does not match /odh_[0-9a-f]{64}/
Add /api/shares routes with no-loss-matrix rows

narrative.Action: PRD WI-5 and Design → 'Routes' (D-4, D-5). Create src/dashboard/server/routes/shares.ts in the routes/triggers.ts idiom: GET /api/shares, POST /api/shares, POST /api/shares/:code/commands, DELETE /api/shares/:code; exported plain async handlers wrapped with Effect.promise; rejectUnsafeDashboardMutationRequest on mutations, rejectUnauthorizedDashboardRequest on GET; Cache-Control: no-store. POST validates conversationName, checks getConversationByName (404 conversation_not_found) and conversationWriteRefusal (409), then ShareManager.create. Command validation allows only admit/kick/revoke/unrevoke/set-contributor with a positive safe integer githubId. Normalize :code like the Worker. Register sharesRouteLayer in src/dashboard/server/server.ts makeRoutesLayer next to triggersRouteLayer. Add the four rows from the PRD to tests/unit/lib/overdeck/no-loss-matrix.ts under a '// ── shares.ts ──' comment. Test harness: tests/unit/dashboard/server/routes/triggers-admin.test.ts; inject the manager with setShareManagerForTests.

items.title: Given a valid local conversation and a fake manager, when POST /api/shares runs, then it returns 201 with a joinUrl ending in /s/<shortCode>, and a repeat POST returns 200 with the same shortCode
Given an unknown conversation name, when POST /api/shares runs, then it returns 404 conversation_not_found; given a released conversation, then it returns 409
Given command bodies {type:'end'}, {type:'signal'}, {githubId:0} or set-contributor without contributor, when POST /api/shares/:code/commands runs, then each returns 400 invalid_command
Given responses from all four routes in the test, when each body is checked, then none matches /odh_[0-9a-f]{64}/

When npx vitest run tests/unit/lib/overdeck/no-loss-matrix.test.ts runs, then it reports zero missing surfaces and the matrix contains GET /api/shares, POST /api/shares, POST /api/shares/:code/commands and DELETE /api/shares/:code
Integration test: stub viewer through lobby, admit, kick, revoke and end on real workerd

narrative.Action: PRD WI-6. Create tests/integration/services/share/host-manager.test.ts. Copy (do not import from or edit) the setup of tests/integration/services/share/miniflare.test.ts: ACCOUNT_STUB, tokenFor, OWNER, VIEWER_A, the wrangler dry-run bundle and Miniflare construction. Build a real ShareManager with readShareUrl -> the mf.ready URL without a trailing slash, readAccount -> an AccountRecord with accessToken tokenFor(OWNER.id), the real createRoom/deleteRoom, a temp OVERDECK_HOME for the record file, and the real defaultOpenSocket. Drive: create -> connected; stub viewer joins via mf.dispatchFetch(BASE + '/v1/rooms/<code>/join?v=1', {headers:{Upgrade:'websocket', Authorization:'Bearer '+tokenFor(VIEWER_A.id)}}) -> lobby; admit with contributor:true -> admitted + contributor; kick -> gone, viewer closed 4010; rejoin -> lobby; revoke -> blocked; unrevoke -> blocked empty; end -> record file empty, viewer closed 4004. Use vi.waitFor or socket events; no fixed sleeps. IMPLEMENTATION CHECKPOINT: if the ws client cannot reach the mf.ready URL, inject openSocket with an adapter wrapping mf.dispatchFetch(...).webSocket.accept() into ShareSocket and comment why. Also verify workerd answers ws protocol pings (D-11); if not, remove keepalive from share-host.ts and record the reason there. Give beforeAll and every it the same SLOW timeout (60_000 ms) as miniflare.test.ts: the wrangler dry-run bundle exceeds vitest's 5 s default.

items.title: Given a ShareManager pointed at Miniflare, when a stub viewer opens the join socket, then manager.list() shows that viewer with state lobby
Given the viewer in the lobby, when the manager sends admit with contributor true, then the next snapshot shows the viewer admitted with contributor true
Given an admitted viewer, when kick is sent, then the viewer socket closes with 4010 and the snapshot no longer lists the viewer
Given a rejoined viewer, when revoke then unrevoke are sent, then the snapshot lists the viewer in blocked and then shows blocked empty
When manager.end(code) runs, then shared-sessions.json holds no rooms and the viewer socket closes with 4004
Create the shareApi module and SharingLobbyPanel component

narrative.Action: PRD WI-7 and Design → Frontend (shareApi.ts, SharingLobbyPanel.tsx). shareApi.ts: SHARES_QUERY_KEY=['shares'], listShares (fetchWithTimeout from lib/apiFetch.ts), createShare, sendShareCommand, endShare (fetch with dashboardMutationJsonHeaders from lib/wsTransport.ts), ShareApiError {status,error,message}, useShares({enabled}) with refetchInterval 1000. SharingLobbyPanel({share, onCommand, pending}): sections 'Waiting to join (N)', 'In the room (N)', 'Blocked (N)', empty-state text, avatar 20px rounded-sm with alt='', @login in font-mono, markers contributor/offline/controller, lastError alert messages, seven buttons mapped exactly to the commands in the PRD, aria-labels including the login (e.g. 'Admit @alice as contributor'), buttons disabled unless connection === 'connected'. Follow pan-style-guide (no rounded-full, font-medium, no hex, Revoke/Kick as the destructive style). Add the test path to scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt in sorted position.

items.title: Given a ShareView fixture with lobby, admitted and blocked identities, when SharingLobbyPanel renders, then it shows the headings 'Waiting to join', 'In the room' and 'Blocked' with each @login
Given a lobby participant alice (githubId 100), when 'Admit @alice as contributor' is clicked, then onCommand receives exactly {type:'admit', githubId:100, contributor:true}

Given an admitted contributor, when 'Remove contributor' is clicked, then onCommand receives {type:'set-contributor', githubId, contributor:false}; Un-revoke on a blocked identity emits {type:'unrevoke', githubId}

Given lastError {code:'unknown_participant'}, when the panel renders, then a role=alert element shows 'That person is no longer in the room.'
